## Core Mechanized Invariants & Microarchitectural Bounds
- **I1 (Non-Authorization State Conservation):** $D(a) = \text{DENY} \implies \Delta_{\text{external}}(a) = 0$
  - **Actuator Command Gate:** $\text{Gate}(a) = \text{DENY} \implies \text{Command}_{\text{actuator}} = \mathbf{0}$ (Zero unauthorized command emission; active holding torque / ballast seals autonomous)
  - **Frame Invariant:** $\forall s, a, s': (s \xrightarrow{a} s' \land a \in \mathcal{A}_{\text{prop}} \land D(s,a) = \text{DENY}) \implies \pi_P(\text{Commit}(s,a)) = \pi_P(s) \land \text{Effects}_{\text{ext}}(s,a) = \emptyset$
- **I2 (Single-Commit Effect Gate):** $\sum_{e \in E(o)} \mathbf{1}[\text{Committed}(e, t)] \le 1$
- **I3 (Zero Ambient Authority):** Atomic capability-bound tokens; proposal generation strictly decoupled from execution authority (Proposer != Executor).
- **Physical Memory Bounds ($S_{\max}$):** $\le 4096\text{ B}$ static frame budget (`#![no_std]`, TCM physical bounds $[1024..=2048]$).
- **Dynamic Allocation ($M_{\text{alloc}}$):** $0\text{ B}$ on critical ingress and evaluation paths (`#![no_std]`, `#[forbid(unsafe_code)]`).
- **Cyber-Physical Timing & Latency Clamps:**
  - **Total Latency Budget ($T_{\text{total}}$):** $\tau_{\text{sense}} (1.50\text{ms}) + \tau_{\text{eval}} (10.00\text{ms}) + \tau_{\text{sync}} (1.20\text{ms}) + \tau_{\text{brake\_engage}} (1.81\text{ms}) = 14.51\text{ms} \le 16.50\text{ms}$ (Preserves $1.99\text{ms}$ certified timing slack).
  - **Hardware Evaluation Watchdog Ceiling ($\tau_{\text{eval}}$):** $\le T_{\text{cycle}} \le 10.00\text{ms}$ synchronized to discrete hold duration.
  - **Fallback Hardware Actuator:** APIC NMI line + isolated hardware watchdog power-bridge coil interlock.
- **Stopping Envelope Inclusive of Mechanical Latch Buffer ($M_{\text{stop}}^L$):**
  - $M_{\text{stop}}^L(v) = v T_{\text{total}} + \frac{1}{2} a_{\max} T_{\text{total}}^2 + \frac{(v + a_{\max} T_{\text{total}})^2}{2 a_{\text{brake}}} + d_{\text{latch}}$
  - $d_{\text{latch}} = \frac{\epsilon_v^2}{2 a_{\text{brake}}} + \epsilon_v \tau_{\text{latch\_lock}}$ (Guarantees zero boundary overrun during velocity deadband engagement).
- **Constructive Outward Rational Margin ($\gamma \in \mathbb{Q}$):** $\gamma = 2^{-p} \lceil 2^p (\epsilon_d + K_M^{\text{cert}} \epsilon_v) \rceil \in \mathbb{Q}$.
- **Sovereign Constancy ($C_{\text{ops}}$):** $= 0$ operational drag ($T_{\text{remediation}} \to 0$ via the VCI Protocol).

## Normative Poset Dominance & Categorical Bridge (ARC-ERR-2026-001)
- **Normative Operational Poset (E):**  
  $\text{BREACH (POSIX 40)} \succ \text{REFUSAL (POSIX 32)} \succ \text{CORRUPT (POSIX 30)} \succ \text{PWC (POSIX 12)} \succ \text{FREEZE (POSIX 10)} \succ \text{PASS (POSIX 0)}$
- **Pre-Ingress Join-Semilattice (L):**  
  $L = \{\bot\text{ (PASS)}, l_1\text{ (PWC)}, l_2\text{ (CORRUPT)}, l_3\text{ (REFUSAL)}, \top\text{ (BREACH)}\}$
- **Endofunctorial Yield Invariant:**  
  $\Phi : L \to E$ maps faithfully into $\operatorname{Im}(\Phi) = \{0, 12, 30, 32, 40\}$. $\text{POSIX 10 (FREEZE)}$ operates strictly outside $\operatorname{Im}(\Phi)$ as an internal runtime rate clamp ($\tau_{\text{eval}} \le 10.00\text{ms}$).
